collectible.title: Curry Noodles
collectible.subtitle: A perfect meal for a cold winter's night!
collectible.text:
Out of the kindness of her heart, Nadeshiko has gifted you a tasty cup of ramen noodles, on the bottom of the cup, there's a note:
"I was given a cup of these very noodles when I met Rin for the first time, so I decided to pay the favor onto you! All you need to do is boil some water, pour it in the cup, and the 2-3 minutes later, you'll have tasty ramen, ready to go! I hope you enjoy them!" -Nadeshiko
collectible.unlock: See Nadeshiko eat (and finish) a cup of curry noodles.

collectible.title: Nadeshiko's Number
collectible.subtitle: Be sure to call her later!
collectible.text: As you prepare to walk out of the Inventory tonight, Nadeshiko stops you. In her hand is a small slip of paper, which she then hands off to you. Written on it is her phone number, a photograph, and a note. She gives you a warm smile as you head home.

collectible.title: Skillet
collectible.subtitle: Perfect for cooking in the great outdoors!
collectible.text: Working for an outdoors store has it's benefits. After your last game with her, she decided to pick one up for you (thanks to an employee discount), as a way to share the love of the outdoors, and outdoor cooking with you. "I already prepared it for cooking too, so whenever you want to use it, it's ready to go!"
collectible.unlock: Beat Nadeshiko two times. You don't have to win.

collectible.title: Nadeshiko's Scarf
collectible.subtitle: The perfect camping accesory!
collectible.text: Nadeshiko wanted to thank you for listening to her camping tips. As you prepare to leave, she hands you a scarf, identical to her's. "They were selling this at the outdoor's store I work at not too long ago, and I thought that, perhaps, you should have it!" You wrap the scarf around your neck as you get up to leave. It really does feel comfy.

collectible.title: Nadeshiko's Boots
collectible.subtitle: Great for outdoor activities!
collectible.text: Nadeshiko is incredibly flattered. The fact you loved her scarf so much, that you chose to keep in on, made her want to give you one more gift. Before you leave, Nadeshiko hands you a big shoe box. Inside, are a pair of boots, almost identical to hers. She gives you a gentle smile before walking away. As you put them on, you're surprised with how... comfortable they are. It's really making you want to go on a camping trip to show them off.
collectible.unlock: Keep Nadeshiko's Scarf on for the entire game.
